Garnet RTX5090: all verified comparison charts

The overall 2× target is unmet. These charts contain three native configurations, each with three trials, and retained ordinary vLLM/SGLang references with one trial each. Stronger tuned/MTP reference qualification remains pending. All results, including regressions, are retained.

OverviewFirst tokenDecodeThroughputVRAM
  • 3968 input + 128 output; 8 measured requests/cohort; text/image; clients 1,2,4,8; one RTX5090 32GB; mixed NVFP4/FP8.
  • All three native lines: median of three cohort statistics; new-policy band: observed min-max, not confidence intervals. VRAM: maximum across trials.
  • Three repeats per native worker; ordinary refs one each. Windows/WSL. Resident+serial is one combined policy; both B4 configurations prefill32.
  • Native B1 queues; native B4 uses fixed microbatches with private padding; references allow8 active requests. Dummy tokens excluded.
  • Native GDN/reference SSM recurrent state: FP32; attention KV: BF16. Native conv state: FP32; reference conv dtype unverified. Prefix/radix cache off.
  • All372 resident/serial prompt/output sequences match retained B1. Reference long-output variants remain; cross-engine equivalence unproven.
  • Adapter VRAM includes background allocations; not process/instantaneous peak. Maximum new-policy sample gap: 15.649s.
  • Dashed guides use measured ordinary references only. Stronger tuned/MTP references and matched INT4/4B comparisons pending; overall2x unmet.
